payload.body: You tend to hear about another person's shame, longing, mistake, or private fear without reducing them to it. You can also recognize your own complicated feelings without immediately turning them into a secret or a crisis. Imagination and compassion make room for what is difficult to explain. People often feel understood around you because you do not demand a simple version of their inner life.
